name: Cold brew
description: Coffee steeped in cold water for half a day — less acidic, more caffeinated.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; served cold but warming in nature.

histamine.note: Same mild reading as coffee. The twelve-hour steep at room temperature is the part worth watching, not a DAO effect.

stimulant.note: Caffeine alone. The long cold steep pulls less acid, not less caffeine.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
